title: Assembly Manifest
description: Pacing-aware assembly manifest produced by the Assembly Director. Defines the complete timeline with cut points, volumes, animations, and framing for every clip.

cut_id.description: Unique cut identifier in timeline order

scene_id.description: Scene identifier from the segment plan

source.description: Path to the source footage file

in_seconds.description: Start point within the source clip

out_seconds.description: End point within the source clip

animation.description: Ken Burns or motion animation type (e.g. slow_zoom_out, pan_left, static)

framing.description: Aspect ratio handling (e.g. native, letterbox, center_crop, pillar_box)
